name: electric-logo
title: Electric Logo
description: Any logo shape outlined by restless electric strands, glowing blue-white on black. The current wanders along the edge, throws short arcs, and flares brighter as the pointer nears.
use: A brand mark, game icon or badge that should feel charged, alive or high-voltage.
avoid: It is decorative only, needs a sized parent, and the constant crackle is costly on weak GPUs.
a11y: The container exposes no role, name or aria-hidden flag, and the pointer flare has no keyboard route. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A tall lightning bolt glows in pale electric light on pure black, its outline not a clean line but a bundle of thin wavering filaments. Soft blue halos follow the shape and faint loops of current flicker around the corners.
behaves: The edge never rests: strands drift and swell while brightness pulses and short arcs snap across the notches. Moving the pointer close heats the glow and draws more arcs, and a click sends a ripple and flash along the mark.
customise: Pass any logo through src and set the core and glow colours, scale, intensity, strand count, thickness, bend, crackle, arcs and flicker. Speed, fill, cursor response and theme are props.
weight: heavy: A full-screen shader runs six wandering strands and five arc fields every frame.
